releases.notes: Stop keeps the music queue and place ('resume' plays on), new 'clear the queue' command; 'stop the playback, please' and other polite words anywhere in a short command; the assistant no longer says it will remember without saving; links to the program site, the guide and all voice commands in Settings.

Timer through the model and short phrases up to 8 words; fast phrases after a past-chat search (more, previous results, open the second one); weather, time, timer and similar exchanges are marked as commands unless you say 'keep this in the chat'.

Second public alpha. Cross-chat memory (alpha, with a switch), icons on the tabs and buttons, text size choice, roomier chats list, command exchanges kept out of summaries, answer cut/refusal notices, new voice commands (skip answer, rephrase). Bring your own Qwen and DeepSeek keys.
